name: Hall's Garage
old_description: Family-owned and operated since 1966, Hall's Garage has served the town of Scituate and Providence County with quality used OEM auto parts. We specialize in late model vehicles of all makes, including cars, trucks, SUVs, vans, and heavy trucks. We also have a selection of classic cars!
about:
Hall's Garage has operated in Scituate, Rhode Island, since 1966. The family-owned business serves the town and surrounding Providence County with used original-equipment auto parts. No founder names are provided in the source material.

The company stocks late-model parts for cars, trucks, SUVs, vans, and heavy trucks, and also carries a selection of classic-car components. In addition to parts sales, Hall's Garage sells used cars and trucks, buys vehicles from the public, provides Rhode Island state safety inspections, and runs a 24-hour towing service. No facility size, headcount, or inventory counts are disclosed.

Customers include local vehicle owners, heavy-truck operators, and classic-car enthusiasts in the Scituate area. The business also reaches buyers through an eBay storefront. No specific industrial or fleet accounts are named.

The company emphasizes its long-standing local presence and family ownership as markers of reliability. It does not state a founding mission or unique value proposition beyond longevity and breadth of used-part inventory.
